conservation_assessment.note: Official assessment data are shown only after a provenance-validated import.

trend.methodology_note: This is a normalized occurrence-record index (peak year = 100), not a population-abundance estimate. The current, incomplete year is excluded.

occurrence_history.note: Occurrence records and their normalized index are not population-abundance estimates.

geographic_distribution.attribution_method: point-in-polygon against geoBoundaries IND ADM1, nearest state within a 10 km coastal tolerance
geographic_distribution.uncertainty_note: Many records are deliberately obscured (> 10 km); state attribution near borders is approximate.

records_used.rule: records with stated coordinate uncertainty of at most 10 km

records_left_out.reason: Coarse coordinates are usually obscured by the publisher to protect threatened species and can lie tens of km from the true location; records without a stated uncertainty cannot be checked.

sources.legal_forest_categories: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN, Protected Planet WDPA/WD-OECM
sources.other_designations: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN, Protected Planet WDPA/WD-OECM

definitions.wildlife_protected_areas: National Parks, Wildlife Sanctuaries, Conservation Reserves and Community Reserves mapped in OpenStreetMap.
definitions.tiger_reserves: Tiger reserves mapped in OpenStreetMap. They include buffer zones, so they are not part of the wildlife protected-area figure.
definitions.legal_forest_categories: Reserve, Reserved, Protected and Unclassed Forests from WDPA. These are forest-law categories, not wildlife protected areas.
definitions.other_designations: Ramsar sites, Biodiversity Heritage Sites, Biosphere Reserves and other WDPA designations.

protected_area_coverage.methodology_note: Each percentage is the share of the records used (within 10 km) intersecting that layer; it is null when no records qualify. It is not an estimate of habitat protection, range protection, or conservation effectiveness. Proposed sites, eco-sensitive zones, buffers and corridors are excluded.
protected_area_coverage.limitation: OpenStreetMap boundaries are community-mapped and not an official Government of India list; some sites may be missing or approximate.

derived_watchlist_signal.note: MODEL PREDICTION - not an official IUCN Red List assessment.

data_gaps.habitat: IUCN habitat classifications are not imported
data_gaps.environmental_exposure: baseline climate (WorldClim 1970-2000) and land-use conditions only; no climate-change projections
